definition: A person whose gender identity matches the sex they were assigned at birth.
An umbrella term for gender identities that aren’t exclusively male or female.
Words used to refer to someone (e.g., he/him, she/her, they/them) that affirm their gender identity.
The way different identities (race, gender, sexuality, class, etc.) overlap and impact experience of privilege or oppression.
Everyday verbal or behavioral slights—intentional or not—that communicate hostile or negative messages to marginalized people.
An environment in which LGBTQ+ people can be their authentic selves without fear of discrimination or harassment.
A network of friends and mentors who provide the support that one’s biological family may not.
